usedFor: Benchmark Email holds contacts, lists and surveys, and “Update a Contact” and “Create a Segment” keep them current.

bestTemplate.name: “New Deal Won” in Teamgate, then “Update Details of a Survey” in Benchmark Email
bestTemplate.why: A won deal is a natural moment to change a survey, and the action updates its details.

watchOut: “Delete a list” in Benchmark Email removes an existing list, so be sure the right one is picked.
